bundle.shortDescription: Mod manager for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
bundle.longDescription: Browse, enable/disable and clean up Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition mods. Reads local and subscribed mod folders, saves mod presets, and installs mods from the official Age of Empires mod service.
